name: Multi-head sensor light
desc: A flexible wall-light format for entrances, driveways and boundary walls. Adjustable lamp heads help direct light toward different parts of the approach.
consider: Choose an exposed wall position with useful daylight. Confirm detection coverage and the chosen operating mode before ordering.
questions: Required light output and illuminated area
Sensor range, angle and operating modes
Battery capacity, service access and winter runtime

name: Split-panel security light
desc: Separate the panel position from the light position. A useful starting point when an entrance is shaded but a nearby wall or roof edge receives more sunlight.
consider: Plan the panel position and cable route together. Confirm cable length, connector protection and the complete accessory list for your configuration.
questions: Panel location and required cable length
Battery and panel pairing for the chosen mode
Cable routing and supplied mounting accessories

name: Compact wall sensor
desc: A compact integrated format for doorways, side passages and residential boundary walls. A straightforward family to consider for a focused retail or distributor range.
consider: Check mounting height and nearby obstructions. Final output, detection settings and enclosure rating depend on the selected model.

name: Slim wall sensor light
desc: A low-profile wall-mounted light for side entrances and paths alongside a building. Its compact form supports a smaller, easy-to-understand assortment.
consider: Review the exact configuration and mounting drawing during sample approval. A slim form alone does not indicate light output or coverage.
questions: Requested control modes and light color

name: Split solar floodlight
desc: A separate-panel floodlight format for yards and perimeter areas. Begin with the mounting position, required coverage and daily operating schedule to define the right configuration.
consider: For larger areas, use a lighting plan. Confirm usable lumens, beam angle, mounting height and runtime together rather than selecting by headline wattage.
questions: Usable light output and supporting test data

name: Solar garden spotlight
desc: A complementary landscape family for planting, garden paths and feature lighting. Pair it with motion-sensor wall lights when building a broader outdoor range.
consider: Treat accent lighting separately from security coverage. Check ground conditions, planting growth and panel exposure at the chosen location.
questions: Accent lighting or path guidance requirement
Preferred light color and evening schedule
Pack size, packaging and seasonal range planning
